name: Tsunderella
source:
Tsunderella works in crossdressing bar owned by his stepmother.
At present his job consists of cleaning and cooking, but from the day of his upcoming birthday he will be forced to serve customers.
Since Tsunderella's father is usually away from home, and he's regularly bullied by his step sisters, he often feels lonely.
His only friend is [url=https://vndb.org/c42363]Thomas[/url].
Tsunderella's hobby is gardening.
